description: Full observed history of one pseudonymous journey (visits, signups, payments) in time order, so you can say how a customer found the site. Take journey_id from the journeys tool. Paginate with cursor.

journey_id.description: journey_id from the journeys tool (64 lowercase hex characters)

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website
